pages.text: Press $(thing)J$() (change it in Controls) to open $(thing)My Company$(): a list of all your companions, even the ones far away or in other dimensions.$(br2)Each row shows the class, level, health, stance and where they are: the distance, or the dimension and coordinates. $(thing)far$() means their area is not loaded.

$(li)$(thing)Call$(): brings that companion to you.$(li)$(thing)Call everyone$(): brings all of them.$(li)The $(thing)stance$() button cycles Follow, Guard and Stay. It only works for companions whose area is loaded: call them first.$(li)$(thing)Formation$(): the same choice as the $(l:epicvanguard:commanding/war_horn)War Horn$().
